##### Project general facts

La Tilia is a residential community within Villanova, offering a collection of spacious 3- and 4-bedroom townhouses in a gated, family-friendly environment surrounded by lush greenery. Designed with a strong focus on comfort, privacy, and outdoor living, the development features modern architecture integrated with landscaped parks and open spaces. Each home is thoughtfully positioned to provide a peaceful setting while maintaining easy access to the community’s facilities and everyday conveniences.

The community offers a wide range of amenities designed to encourage an active and social lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a central park with walking, running, and cycling trails, a community swimming pool, children’s play areas, and multi-purpose sports courts. The master community also features sports facilities, retail outlets, a mosque, and additional landscaped spaces, creating a well-rounded environment for families of all ages.

La Tilia residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating comfortable and contemporary interiors. Each home comes with an equipped kitchen, while the residences are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their living spaces according to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Villanova, located in Dubailand, is a community designed to foster a sense of connection and tranquility. Surrounded by expansive green spaces, parks, and lush pathways, the neighborhood emphasizes a close-knit feel, creating an ideal setting for family life. The area features a range of amenities, including playgrounds, swimming pools, and sports facilities, all crafted to support an active, family-centered lifestyle. With thoughtfully planned spaces, Villanova encourages residents to enjoy nature and outdoor living while providing all the necessities for daily life within a secure, friendly environment.

The strategic location of Villanova in Dubailand offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major attractions and infrastructure. Situated along Emirates Road and easily accessible via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road, Villanova ensures residents can reach key destinations, including the Hamdan Sports Complex, Global Village, Al Maktoum International Airport, and Downtown Dubai, with ease. This accessibility makes it a convenient yet serene choice, balancing a peaceful suburban atmosphere with proximity to the city’s bustling areas.

Villanova’s layout and design prioritize comfort, privacy, and community engagement. The neighborhood is enriched by beautifully landscaped green belts and walkways that encourage leisurely strolls, while the central community facilities serve as gathering points for families and neighbors. With a range of townhouses and villas designed in Mediterranean-inspired architecture, Villanova presents an aesthetically pleasing yet practical living space that supports family growth, relaxation, and the creation of cherished memories in a warm, welcoming environment.
